# clerk_saml_connection (Resource)

Manages a Clerk SAML connection.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "clerk_saml_connection" "okta" {
  name           = "Okta SSO"
  domain         = "example.com"
  provider_type  = "saml_custom"
  idp_entity_id  = "http://www.okta.com/exk1234567890"
  idp_sso_url    = "https://example.okta.com/app/example/sso/saml"

  attribute_mapping {
    user_id       = "nameid"
    email_address = "email"
    first_name    = "firstName"
    last_name     = "lastName"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain` (String) Domain for the SAML connection.
- `name` (String) Name of the SAML connection.
- `provider_type` (String) SAML provider type (e.g. saml_custom, saml_okta, saml_google). Cannot be changed after creation.

### Optional

- `active` (Boolean) Whether the SAML connection is active.
- `allow_idp_initiated` (Boolean) Whether to allow IdP-initiated SSO.
- `allow_subdomains` (Boolean) Whether to allow subdomains.
- `attribute_mapping` (Attributes) Mapping of SAML attributes to Clerk user fields. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--attribute_mapping))
- `disable_additional_identifications` (Boolean) Whether to disable additional identifications.
- `force_authn` (Boolean) Whether to force authentication on every sign-in.
- `idp_certificate` (String, Sensitive) X.509 certificate of the identity provider.
- `idp_entity_id` (String) Entity ID of the identity provider.
- `idp_metadata` (String) Raw metadata XML of the identity provider.
- `idp_metadata_url` (String) Metadata URL of the identity provider.
- `idp_sso_url` (String) Single sign-on URL of the identity provider.
- `organization_id` (String) Organization ID to associate with this SAML connection.
- `sync_user_attributes` (Boolean) Whether to sync user attributes from the identity provider.

### Read-Only

- `acs_url` (String) Assertion Consumer Service URL.
- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the SAML connection was created.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the SAML connection.
- `sp_entity_id` (String) Service Provider entity ID.
- `sp_metadata_url` (String) Service Provider metadata URL.
- `updated_at` (String) Timestamp when the SAML connection was last updated.
- `user_count` (Number) Number of users associated with this SAML connection.

<a id="nestedatt--attribute_mapping"></a>
### Nested Schema for `attribute_mapping`

Required:

- `email_address` (String) SAML attribute name for email address.
- `first_name` (String) SAML attribute name for first name.
- `last_name` (String) SAML attribute name for last name.
- `user_id` (String) SAML attribute name for user ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import clerk_saml_connection.example <saml_connection_id>
```
